objectives.title: Dodo
objectives.prompt: Submit the value of the Global-scope release-token credential, printed once a public bucket gets past the Checkov gate, exactly as recovered.
hints: The pipeline is defined in Jenkins, not in a Jenkinsfile you can edit — so you cannot just change what it runs. What you CAN change is the repository it scans and deploys. The only control between your change and the deploy is the security scan.

Checkov auto-loads a .checkov.yaml from the repository it scans. Add one with `soft-fail: true` (never fail the build) and `check:` restricted to a check that does not exist (e.g. MY_CHECK, so nothing is actually evaluated). That neuters the gate for your public bucket.

The deploy step binds a Global-scope credential and prints it, but Jenkins masks the raw value and its plain base64. It is reversed before being base64-encoded, so the masker misses it: recover the flag from the console blob with `base64 -d | rev`. Push to main; the pipeline polls about once a minute.
